products.title: Guard Passing Essentials by Marcelo Garcia
products.body:
Unlock one of the most important skills in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu with Guard Passing Essentials by Marcelo Garcia — a true legend of the sport and widely regarded as one of the greatest competitors of all time.

  • A 5-time Black Belt World Champion in the gi, Marcelo built his reputation on precision, efficiency, and a deep understanding of positional dominance.
  • In this instructional series, Marcelo breaks down his approach to guard passing into clear, simple, and highly effective concepts that work at every level.
  • Rather than overwhelming you with countless techniques, he focuses on timing, posture, pressure, and decision-making — the core principles that make guard passing reliable against even the toughest opponents.
  • Whether you're struggling to open the guard or looking to refine a pressure-based passing system, this is a masterclass in applying fundamentals with world-class execution



What Will You Learn?

Unlock one of the most important skills in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu with Guard Passing Essentials by Marcelo Garcia — a true legend of the sport and widely regarded as one of the greatest competitors of all time. A 5-time Black Belt World Champion in the gi, Marcelo built his reputation on precision, efficiency, and a deep understanding of positional dominance.

In this instructional series, Marcelo breaks down his approach to guard passing into clear, simple, and highly effective concepts that work at every level. Rather than overwhelming you with countless techniques, he focuses on timing, posture, pressure, and decision-making — the core principles that make guard passing reliable against even the toughest opponents.

Whether you're struggling to open the guard or looking to refine a pressure-based passing system, this is a masterclass in applying fundamentals with world-class execution.

Key Benefits 

  • Learn guard passing from a 5x Black Belt World Champion

  • Focus on simple, high-percentage techniques that work in real rolls

  • Master the core concepts: posture, pressure, angles, and timing

  • Develop a systematic approach to breaking and passing the guard

  • Eliminate guesswork with clear decision-making frameworks

  • Improve control and efficiency — pass without wasting energy

  • Applicable for all levels, from white belt to advanced competitors

  • Designed specifically for gi training and competition

  • Build a reliable passing style rooted in fundamentals, not gimmicks

  • Train like one of the most respected technicians in BJJ history

products.title: The Complete No Gi Guard Passing System by Marcelo Garcia
products.body:
See Marcelo Garcia’s step-by-step process for passing the no-gi guard, including some never before seen details in this exclusive series filmed JUST FOR BJJ FANATICS!

  • Marcelo is a 9-time World Champion and known for his creative combinations and crisp technique that work at every level and in every style of submission grappling
  • This four-part instructional series covers Marcelo’s standing passes, back steps, half guard passes, and more, including how to combine them into one smooth system
  • Attack with a plan against common no-gi guards, including butterfly, inverted guard, De La Riva, and more


Pass And Attack In No-Gi With 9-Time World Champion Marcelo Garcia’s Passing System That Made Him One Of The Best Grapplers Ever

Marcelo Garcia Teaches His Entire Flawless Passing System That Destroys The No-Gi Guard

Check Out A Free Sample:

What Will You Learn?

Learn from one of the best submission grapplers ever, as 9-Time World Champion Marcelo Garcia teaches his entire no-gi passing system that anyone can use to attack the guard and get to dominant positions fast. Over this 4-part series, you will get every detail to battle-tested passes, including all of Marcelo’s signature techniques.

Use back-steps, knee cuts, x passes, and more to get past the guard, with Marcelo showing every option for countering and staying ahead of guard players. Marcelo Garcia explains everything you will need for passing success, with all the no-gi keys to control.

These no-gi techniques were perfected by Marcelo to work all the time, even when his opponents were bigger and stronger than him. That is why, over and over, Marcelo was able to fight and submit much larger opponents, by using techniques like these to give himself the advantage back.

Stop guard players and shut down their game with Marcelo’s advice on dealing with tricky and dangerous no-gi guards. Kill the butterfly guard, the De La Riva, inverted guard, half guard, and more, before turning it into your advantage all over again with Marcelo’s gameplan.

So, What Exactly Do You Get?

products.body:
Get a total masterclass in the most successful butterfly guard of all time, as Marcelo Garcia teaches how to attack and defend from his favorite guard position

  • See Marcelo Garcia’s step-by-step process for passing the no-gi guard and see how he shuts down dangerous grapplers while finding dominant positions against talented opposition

Develop A Complete & Total Game As One Of Grappling’s Greatest Coaches & Athletes - Marcelo Garcia - Reveals His Secrets To Some Of His Most Recognizable And Famous Systems & Techniques On This Six-Series Bundle!

What Will You Learn?

Get over 20 volumes of technique, and hours of hours of content, with this special six-volume bundle as ADCC & IBJJF World Champion Marcelo Garcia shows you some of his best positions for attacking on the mat - including the crucifix, the north south choke, and much more. With options for everywhere, expect techniques and strategies that can revolutionize your entire grappling style with one of the most revolutionary athletes in the history of the sport.


This bundle includes:

  • The Complete Butterfly Guard
  • The Complete North South Choke
  • The Complete No-Gi Guard Passing System
  • The Complete Side Control System
  • The Complete MG Mount System

This bundle can be your shortcut to a more well-rounded and complete game on the mat, with options for guard, passing, dominant positions, and fight-ending submissions. Marcelo is a 9-time world champion in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & submission grappling using these same systems, and has now become one of the most well-respected and successful coaches in the world with many champion students.

Learn at your own pace with this personal library from one of the best teachers and coaches there is, as Marcelo shows you the passes, sweeps, submissions, back takes, and more that helped make his career so amazing. With dozens of hours of content packed with detail, this is a secondary instructor you’ll be able to keep coming back to as you learn for years to come.
